label: Slack: Upload File
description: Share a stored file into a channel (optionally inside a thread), with an optional title and comment. Uses Slack's external-upload flow, the only upload path Slack still supports.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Slack access (wire a SlackAccess node). Needs the files:write scope.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: The stored file to share (from FetchToStorage, a trigger's attachment, any node emitting a file).

inputs.name: channel
inputs.label: Channel
inputs.placeholder: Pick a channel or paste its id

inputs.name: title
inputs.label: Title
inputs.description: Display name in Slack. Defaults to the stored file's name.

inputs.name: comment
inputs.label: Comment
inputs.description: A message posted alongside the file.

outputs.name: permalink
outputs.description: A link to the shared file.
